motions.item_title: Approve the September 10, 2024 minutes with the changes to the Reports of Action, as noted. Com…
motions.motion: Commissioner Whiting moved to approve the September 10, 2024 minutes with the changes to the Reports of Action, as noted. Commissioner Strong seconded the motion.

motions.item_title: Recommend approval to the City Council of the Dutch Bros Site Plan with the following condition…
motions.motion: Commissioner Allen moved to recommend approval to the City Council of the Dutch Bros Site Plan with the following conditions: 1. The internal roadway in Area A is completed before a certificate of occupancy is issued (Marketplace ARMDA); and 2. The external wall in Area A is completed before a certificate of occupancy is issued (Marketplace ARMDA). Commissioner Fox seconded the motion.
